name: Obstetrics & gynaecology (category guide)
summary: Private O&G continuity vs KKH/NUH referral maths — pregnancy package deposits, foreigner fee honesty, and gynae that is not an IVF clinic.
body: Routine gynae (pap smear, contraception, PCOS, menstrual issues) and obstetric delivery packages are different shopping problems from fertility/IVF centres — start here for women’s health and pregnancy, then branch to fertility listings only if you need assisted conception. Public paths (polyclinic referral → KKH / NUH / SGH) are cheaper for citizens/PRs; foreigners usually pay private-class rates even in public hospitals, so many expats book a private O&G for continuity and WhatsApp access knowing the premium. Ask which hospital the doctor delivers at, what the package includes (epidural, paediatrician standby, NICU exclusions), and the deposit / Letter of Guarantee dance with your insurer — maternity is frequently carved out or waiting-period limited on group plans. Verify SMC specialist registration in Obstetrics & Gynaecology. For non-pregnant gynae, a one-off private consult is often faster than waiting for a subsidised slot you do not qualify for. Pair with maternity and newborn-pass guides for admin after delivery. This is a category guide, not a ranked doctor list.
whenToEngage: Need a gynae for screening or menstrual issues as a foreigner
Comparing private pregnancy packages vs public hospital fees
Insurer maternity waiting periods / LOG limits unclear
Want continuity with one O&G who delivers at a chosen hospital
